_description: Auxiliary teaching/coaching content for BWN that doesn't belong in the structured Rules or Scenarios data. Intended to feed the AI Coach (Learn / Ask) system prompt when it lands.
_source: Excerpted from the BWN Scenario Book and assorted designer notes.
oftenOverlookedRules: All Soviet submarines have rocket-torpedoes, and so score a hit on a non-Anti-Submarine Warfare unit when destroyed in Anti-Submarine Warfare.
An MP air unit which loses a search die due to enemy fighters or its mission is Anti-Submarine Warfare must still take the search die loss.
Soviet units with cruise missiles must use them to attack with unless attacking troops in which case they may choose to use bombs instead.
Small submarines (s) can move OR attack, not both.
All non-MP Air Units become unspent when the ships event happens.
All events take place immediately after the triggering action is completed and fully resolved.
